title: Vibrio nigripulchritudo chromosomes and plasmids on one canvas
summary: Arrange two chromosomes and four plasmids from one RefSeq GBFF file on a shared circular canvas. Start from the Web defaults, then move the plasmids to their own row, choose a palette, and add a plot title, generating after each change.

downloads.label: GCF_015097735.1
downloads.note: Download the RefSeq genomic GBFF and use it as the GenBank input.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Circular mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and check that the Circular drawing is shown before adding the GenBank file.

media.alt: Drawing bar with the Circular drawing tab selected and the + Linear tab beside it.
media.caption: The Circular drawing is shown when the app opens.

manualSteps.title: Upload the GenBank file
manualSteps.body: Upload GCF_015097735.1_ASM1509773v1_genomic.gbff. The app finds the two chromosomes and the four plasmids in the file.

media.alt: Circular input panel with the Vibrio GBFF file selected.
media.caption: GCF_015097735.1_ASM1509773v1_genomic.gbff is selected as the GenBank file.

manualSteps.title: Generate with the defaults
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. Multi-Record Canvas is on by default, so the six records share one canvas. Record Size Mode Auto scales each circle by its length, features sit on two strands (Separate Strands), and the legend is on the left. Record Order fills the rows by record number: the first row holds chromosome 1, chromosome 2, and the plasmid pVNTG1, and the second row holds pVNTG2 to pVNTG4.

media.alt: Vibrio multi-record preview with the Web defaults: chromosome 1, chromosome 2, and plasmid pVNTG1 in the first row and pVNTG2 to pVNTG4 in the second, stock colors, left legend, no title.
media.caption: Web defaults: six circles on one canvas; pVNTG1 shares the first row with the chromosomes.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const content = String(app?.results?.[0]?.content || ''); const svg = app?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg) throw new Error('No generated preview.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 0; app.canvasPan.y = 0; } if (app.svgContainer) app.svgContainer.style.setProperty('transform', 'none', 'important'); const width = Math.min(1000, Number(svg.viewBox.baseVal.width) || 1000); const height = width * svg.viewBox.baseVal.height / svg.viewBox.baseVal.width; svg.style.setProperty('width', `${width}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('height', `${height}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-height', 'none', 'important'); svg.setAttribute('data-capture-vnig-preview', 'true');

manualSteps.title: Put the plasmids in their own row
manualSteps.body: Only the two chromosomes belong in the first row. Open Layout and, in Record Order, set the row of record #3 (pVNTG1) to 2. Click Generate Diagram: the chromosomes now share the first row and the four plasmids the second.

replay.script: const labels = ["Layout"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

media.alt: Layout card with Multi-Record Canvas on and the six Record Order rows; the row of record #3 is set to 2.
media.caption: In Record Order, set the row of record #3 (pVNTG1) to 2.

actions.script: const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Multi-Record Canvas')); const row = document.querySelector("select[aria-label^='Row for #3 (']"); if (!label || !row) throw new Error('Multi-Record Canvas controls not found.'); label.dataset.capture = 'multi-record-canvas-toggle'; row.dataset.capture = 'vnig-record-3-row'; document.querySelector("[data-capture='multi-record-canvas-controls']")?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

media.alt: Vibrio multi-record preview with chromosome 1 and chromosome 2 in the first row and plasmids pVNTG1 to pVNTG4 in the second, in the default colors.
media.caption: The chromosomes fill the first row; the four plasmids share the second.

manualSteps.title: Choose a palette
manualSteps.body: Open Colors and choose the orchid palette, then click Generate Diagram. The features, GC content, and GC skew take the orchid colors.

replay.script: const labels = ["Colors"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

manualSteps.title: Add the plot title
manualSteps.body: Open Titles and Record Labels, enter the plot title, and set Plot Title Position to Bottom. Type the <i> tags literally to italicize the species name. Click Generate Diagram to get the Gallery figure.
manualSteps.note: Everything else stays at the Web defaults: Track Preset Tuckin, Separate Strands on, Legend position Left, Record Size Mode Auto, Min Radius Ratio 0.55, Column Gap Ratio 0.1, and Row Gap Ratio 0.05.

replay.script: const labels = ["Titles and Record Labels"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

media.alt: Compact Plot Title controls with the Vibrio title field and Position menu open with Bottom highlighted.
media.caption: Enter the plot title from the table and choose the highlighted Bottom option.

actions.script: () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; return app?.form?.plot_title === 'Vibrio nigripulchritudo TUMSAT-TG-2018, complete genome' && app?.adv?.plot_title_position === 'bottom'; }

manualSteps.title: Inspect a CDS feature
manualSteps.body: Click a CDS feature in the interactive SVG to inspect its label, record ID, location, protein_id, qualifiers, and sequence.

media.alt: Zoomed Vibrio multi-record crop with the clicked CDS on chromosome 1 and its feature popup.
media.caption: The popup header gives the selected chromosome CDS location, and the Details tab its length and protein ID; the Qualifiers and Sequence tabs hold the rest.

troubleshooting.title: Only one record is shown
troubleshooting.body: Check that Multi-Record Canvas is on (the default). Without it, Circular mode draws each record as a separate figure.

troubleshooting.title: pVNTG1 is still in the first row
troubleshooting.body: Check that Record Order puts record #3 in row 2, then click Generate Diagram again.

troubleshooting.title: The plasmids are too small
troubleshooting.body: Raise Min Radius Ratio, or switch Record Size Mode if you need less proportional scaling between chromosomes and plasmids.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Check the GBFF input, Record Order (#1@1, #2@1, #3@2, #4@2, #5@2, #6@2), the orchid palette, and Plot Title Position Bottom. The other settings are the Web defaults.
